_about: AgenticScientist FINAL run (2026-11-23 -> deadline 25 Nov 23:59 AoE = Thu 26 Nov 12:59 CET). One worker per board; the researcher (alternating gpt-6.2-sol / claude-opus-5-5) designs AND implements; promotion review by the other model on accepted candidates; DeepSeek/GLM curate, distil, plan and are the last-resort overflow. Quota: a premium role whose CLI is out of quota runs on agy claude-opus-4-6-thinking, then OpenCode DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, then Command Code DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (then the other researcher); cheap roles fall back to Command Code DeepSeek.

acceptance.rule: screen one seed pair; confirm with all eight paired evaluations; accept when the proxy or changed board clears the margin with a one-sided 95% lower bound, subject to board and condition loss limits

guard._note: Validated 2026-11-18 on Turing: the embryo guard scored the holdout loser w2_c04 -2.9 below the seed; the heart guard scored both heart holdout losers +5 to +6 ABOVE the seed (E10.5 losses are horizon-specific), so heart is judged by its E10.5 holdout only.
